## Estructura Semántica (HTML)

Este template organiza elementos `article` usando una estructura HTML5 semántica limpia y accesible.

```html
<section class="card-grid">
  <article class="card">
    <div class="card-image">
      <img src="https://picsum.photos/400/250" alt="Visual representation of the component" />
    </div>
    <div class="card-content">
      <span class="card-badge">Desarrollo Web</span>
      <h3 class="card-title">Astro v5 en Producción</h3>
      <p class="card-description">Aprende a desplegar tus sitios con el rendimiento óptimo que el nuevo compilador ofrece.</p>
      <a href="#" class="card-btn">Leer más</a>
    </div>
  </article>
  
  <article class="card">
    <div class="card-image">
      <img src="https://picsum.photos/400/250?random=1" alt="Visual representation of the component" />
    </div>
    <div class="card-content">
      <span class="card-badge">Diseño Frontend</span>
      <h3 class="card-title">Diseño de Sistemas</h3>
      <p class="card-description">Crea interfaces consistentes gestionando tokens de colores y tipografías desde CSS.</p>
      <a href="#" class="card-btn">Leer más</a>
    </div>
  </article>
</section>
```

## Estilo Dinámico (CSS)

El uso de `grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr))` permite una adaptación fluida sin depender excesivamente de Media Queries redundantes.

```css
.card-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr));
  gap: 1.5rem;
  padding: 1rem 0;
  width: 100%;
}

.card {
  background: var(--sl-color-bg-sidebar, #17181c);
  border: 1px solid var(--sl-color-hairline-light, #2e3036);
  border-radius: 0.75rem;
  overflow: hidden;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 0.2s;
}

.card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-4px);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
  border-color: var(--sl-color-accent, #3b82f6);
}

.card-image img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 180px;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
}

.card-content {
  padding: 1.25rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  flex-grow: 1;
}

.card-badge {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--sl-color-accent-high, #3b82f6);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
}

.card-title {
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  color: var(--sl-color-white, #ffffff);
}

.card-description {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--sl-color-gray-3, #9ca3af);
  margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
  flex-grow: 1;
}

.card-btn {
  display: inline-block;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
  background-color: var(--sl-color-accent, #3b82f6);
  color: var(--sl-color-bg, #000000) !important;
  text-decoration: none;
  font-weight: 500;
  border-radius: 0.375rem;
  transition: background-color 0.2s;
}

.card-btn:hover {
  background-color: var(--sl-color-accent-high, #2563eb);
}
```
